chapters.title: Chapter 1 — The Storm
chapters.content: Suddenly, the door blew open and the rain came in sideways. Elena grabbed the lamp before it fell. Suddenly, the lights went out, and the whole house dropped into a thick, humming dark. She felt her way along the wall toward the kitchen. Suddenly, a floorboard creaked behind her, close enough that she froze with one hand on the doorframe. She told herself it was the old house settling. Suddenly, the phone rang, shrill in the silence, and she nearly dropped the lamp a second time. She let it ring twice before she answered. Suddenly, a voice she had not heard in years said her name, and the floor seemed to tilt under her. Suddenly, none of the careful plans she had made for the evening mattered at all, and she sat down hard on the cold kitchen tiles to steady herself.
